title: Yander
html:
Yander is the fictional city in Charli Derevanny's Chronicles of Yander series.

"...Yander is the one true world in which all others worlds, including our Earth, are but mere shadows"

Yander is the first shadow of the primal plane of Umba, the city of Yander is the archetype of all cities. Yander casts an infinite number of shadows in all directions in which our own Earth is just but one. The further one travels from Yander the more drastic the changes to the environment become. The Royals of Yander who have negotiated the Pattern can freely travel through the shadows. By shifting between shadows, one can appear to alter reality by simply choosing which elements of which shadows to keep, and which to switch between.
